prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Redesigning the sign_in page for account sync clarity was helpful (+8.0% win) and accurately predicted, while adding hints on sign_in showed no clear effect and prediction was too high.
Adding an interactive pet preview flow (new_flow) on the adoption page was helpful (+8.0% win), though predictions (+10.0%) were slightly too high; other adoption page redesigns showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps on the choose_path page hurt performance (-4.8% loss), and predictions (+5.0%) were far too high.
Layout changes on the choose_path page showed no clear effect, and predictions were too high.
Finish page modifications (redesigns and hints) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Home page modifications (waiting info, new flows, and notification prompts) showed no clear effect across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +8.0% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: +7.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +2.7% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -4.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: -5.0% over 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -8.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +4.8% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.3% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: +8.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.5%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.9%

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Angle Photo Creation Flow: Introduce a structured multi-step photo upload flow with custom angle selectors on upload_photos. (why: Support mail shows 3 users reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong. Providing a guided multi-angle upload flow improves generation accuracy.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Name Confirmation Screen: Add a new screen new_name_pet between pick_friend and upload_photos allowing users to enter a custom name and select a voice style before proceeding. (why: Adoption step has 35.5% drop-off and 89s median time. Giving personal ownership early boosts completion motivation.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Placement Celebration Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout featuring a full mascot animation and warm welcome text celebrating pet placement on desktop. (why: finish step drops 35.2% of remaining users with median time of 395s. Celebrating the arrival makes the completion satisfying.)
3: [sign_in, layout] Centered Sign-In Auth Card Layout: Update the sign_in screen layout to centered with concise auth options and explicit sync status reassurance. (why: 8 support emails noted pets missing or reset after signing in again, making clean and confident auth presentation essential.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Personalization Badge: Display an adoption ribbon badge component on the adoption certificate screen to celebrate pet creation. (why: Adoption drops 35.5% of users. Adding visual reward aesthetics increases perceived completion value.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Preparation Progress: Show explicit step counter and estimated time on the waiting screen while pet assets prepare for desktop deployment. (why: Home step median duration is 201s (mean 2336s). Clear progress metrics prevent dropouts due to perceived freeze.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Personality Path Selection Guidance Hint: Add a descriptive hint on choose_path reassuring users that pet personalities can be tweaked later in settings. (why: Mean time on choose_path is high (514s), suggesting decision anxiety. Reassuring freedom of choice speeds up decisions.)
7: [adoption, copy] Photo Quality Assurance Copy: Update headline and body text on upload_photos to clearly explain how clear pet photos create the best 3D desktop companion. (why: 3 support tickets complained about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong. Clear copy sets expectations.)
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Ready Desktop Notification Prompt: Add a ready notification toggle on home_intro so users get notified if they minimize the app while pet initializes. (why: Finish step mean time is very high (5815s) indicating users switch windows and forget to return to complete setup.)
